title: Bound coordinator HTTP request resources
summary: Remediate AUDIT-FIND-W01-015 by bounding coordinator HTTP connection time, concurrency, and stalled-session shutdown.
reason: An unauthenticated client can currently hold a non-daemon request thread indefinitely by declaring an allowed Content-Length and withholding the body.
behavior_before: Coordinator request threads have no socket timeout or concurrency cap, read bodies before authentication, accept transfer encodings the server does not implement, and can block server_close indefinitely.
behavior_after: Coordinator requests have bounded I/O and handler slots, unsupported transfer encoding is rejected before body reads, server close abandons stalled pre-authentication readers, and authenticated handler cleanup receives one bounded shared join interval.
tests_added: authenticated mutation cleanup is joined during shutdown
concurrent unauthenticated connections cannot exceed the handler cap
incomplete request headers time out on loopback
shutdown abandons a stalled pre-authentication request and returns within a bounded interval
stalled incomplete request body times out on loopback
unsupported transfer encoding is rejected before reading a body
